name: 1000 Most Common Words
description: The 1000 most common everyday words, ranked by real-world usage — core vocabulary for real conversations (English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese).

entries.notes: To find something pleasurable or agreeable, not to compare.
To be aware of a fact or have information, not to be acquainted with a person.
Correct or accurate, not the direction or a legal entitlement.
Final in sequence or duration, not to endure.
To direct your eyes deliberately, not to appear.
A condition or circumstance, not to say something.
To be agreeable to someone, not to request politely.
Not under constraint or costing nothing, not vacant.
To engage in a game or sport, or to perform music/drama. Not to operate a device.
A business organization. Not companionship or being with someone.
To phone someone, or to shout. Not to name or label.
A deity or supreme being. Capitalize when referring to the monotheistic God.
An instance or example, or a container. Multiple senses depending on context.
To transform or alter something. Not coins received back from a purchase.
To reside somewhere, or to be alive. Not to broadcast in real time.
A dot or sharp tip, or the main idea. Not to score in a game.
Present tense: to look at written words. Past tense pronounced differently.
Firm and solid to the touch. Not difficult or demanding.
To signify or have as a meaning. Not unkind or cruel.
To help or back someone. Not to hold something up from underneath.
To say or inform. Can also mean to distinguish or identify.
To cease or halt. Not a bus stop or place to stand.
The bottom foundation of something. Not a military camp or a baseball base.
The top part of your body. Also to be in charge or to move towards.
A mark or row, or a queue. Not a rope or cord.
Sequence and arrangement, or a command. Not a customer request for food.
A political organization. Not a social gathering or celebration.
To move quickly on foot. Multiple other senses (manage, flow, function).
Work done to help others. Not a set of dishes or military duty.
Not closed or blocked. Not operating a business or starting something.
Spring, summer, autumn, or winter. Not to add salt or spices to food.
Vulgar or very informal. Avoid in formal contexts.
A narrative or account of events — not a history of a place or people.
A series of lessons, or a path/direction — not necessarily time passing.
Vulgar slang. Very offensive and explicit.
Events of the past in general — not a specific account or narrative.
A group of students taught together, not a social rank or category.
To shut or seal; can also mean near in distance or time.
Gone by in time; can also mean beyond or by (preposition).
A reason why something happens; can also mean a purpose or principle.
To change position or location; can also mean to affect emotionally.
A request for information; can also mean doubt or to ask.
To pause and expect someone/something; can also mean to serve food.
To depart; can also mean to let remain or permission.
To observe or look at; can also be a timepiece worn on wrist.
Brightness or illumination; can also mean not heavy.
Not high in position, level, or amount; can mean sad or quiet.
Not long in length or time; can mean brief in manner.
To remain in a place; can also mean to stop or delay.
How old someone is; can also mean a period of time.
Why something happens; can also mean to think logically.
A written account; can also mean to tell or announce.
To rotate or spin; can also mean a person's opportunity in order.
To examine or inspect; can also mean a restaurant bill or a pattern.
Physical shape or structure; can also mean a document or to create.
A unit of time (60 seconds); not the adjective meaning small.
To perform or do; can also mean a part of a play or a law.
Burning flames; can also mean to dismiss from a job.
A place where goods are bought/sold; can mean demand.
A scheme or design; can also mean a map or layout.
An agreement or treaty; can also mean to grant or agree.
At an unspecified future time, not a specific date.
An opportunity or possibility, not luck or fortune.
The month, not the action of walking.
A flat surface or panel, not a group of directors.
A topic or problem, not a magazine issue or offspring.
A period of time or a word/expression, not an end.
A calendar day, not a romantic meeting.
Earth or ground, not to arrive or descend.
To fail to hit or reach; to feel the absence of someone.
Biological sex (male/female), not sexual activity.
A bank account or financial record, not a narrative explanation.
A length of time, not punctuation or menstruation.
To guide or direct someone, not the metal or tip of a pencil.
Safety or protection measures, not financial securities or bonds.
An administrative division of a country or region.
To grip or carry, not a storage area on a ship.
To go back, not money given back after a purchase.
To perceive or feel, not meaning or reason.
An opinion or perspective, not what you see from a window.
To cause to snap or crack, not a pause or rest.
Existing now or currently happening, not a gift.
Curiosity or attention in something, not money charged on a loan.
The typical or middle value of a set of numbers.
A financial institution, not the side of a river or a slope.
Sure or confident, not a specific undefined person or thing.
A show or entertainment event; not the act of doing something well.
To apply pressure or push down; not newspapers or media.
A character in a play or film; not a piece of paper.
The monetary value of something; not the same as merit.
Low temperature; not fashionable or impressive.
Someone who leads a film, company, or organization; not a guide.
Soil or earth; also the floor of a building.
A connection between people or things; not limited to romance.
Noise or audio; not emotionally or physically healthy.
Where something comes from or originates; not the main part.
Facts or proof supporting a claim; not an obvious example.
Manufacturing or creating something; also a stage performance.
Shaped like a circle or ball; not a turn or series.
To be upright on your feet; not a stall or booth.
Things or objects; informal and vague, not specific.
To operate a vehicle; not a forceful push or motivation.
The season of harvest; not to drop or tumble.
Quick or speedy; not abstaining from food.
A sports competition or alliance of teams; not a unit of distance.
Running or controlling an organization or activity.
A sports game or competition; not a pair of similar things.
A representation or example; also a person who poses for photos.
A visual image, photo, or painting; not the entire scene.
Belief in someone's reliability; not a business monopoly.
Toward the front or ahead; not a sports position alone.
Metal object opening a lock; also crucial or important.
A variety or selection; also a row or series.
A careful examination; also a critical assessment of a work.
The buying and selling of goods; also a skilled craft.
A person in a story, play, or film; not a personality trait.
A leader or head of a group; not the most important.
Soccer in most regions; a different sport in some countries.
A building or land owned; can also mean a characteristic or quality.
Both the act of voting and a single ballot cast; the noun form.
Finished or whole; can mean to finish something or to make whole.
To include or require as a necessary part; not to engage emotionally.
A platform for performance; also a period or step in a process.
The name of a book, film, or person's rank; not a deed of ownership.
A newspaper piece or essay; can also be a grammar term (a/an/the).
To curse or condemn; can be mild or strong depending on context.
Lacking money; can also mean of low quality or deserving sympathy.
To set free or let go; can also mean to publish or make available.
A system of rules or symbols; can be computer programming or a cipher.
To place something over; can also mean to deal with or include.
To misplace something or be defeated; not to reduce weight.
To choose or select; can also mean to pluck or gather.
A competition of speed; can also refer to ethnic groups.
A symbol or written notice; can also mean to write your name.
A number or statistic, not a person's shape or to work out.
The planet or soil, not the ground as opposite of sky.
Repeated activity to improve skill, not a business or custom.
Formal address for a man; used alone or before a name.
A sign, spot, or symbol — not a grade or a target.
To go by or through; to succeed in a test; to hand over.
A brief record or written message; a musical tone; to notice.
A donkey, not a body part or a rude term for someone foolish.
The subject matter inside something, not satisfaction or happy feeling.
Money lent or delayed payment, not praise or acknowledgement.
To move from one side to the other, not angry or annoyed.
To become a member or connect, not to encounter someone.
A type or category, not arranging things in order.
To communicate with someone, not a person you know.
To fall or let something fall, not a small liquid amount.
Just or reasonable treatment, not a carnival or light-coloured.
The body part, not the base of a mountain or page.
A connection between things, not a chain or hyperlink.
A requirement or state of something, not a medical illness.
The natural world and wildlife, not someone's character.
A sports trainer, not a large bus or instructor in another context.
To assert or state as fact, not to demand or stake a right.
To be the right size or shape; to suit or belong in a space.
A written message, not a character of the alphabet.
No longer; not now as before. Used for stopped or ended actions.
A counter serving drinks, not a rod or a court case.
A legal agreement, not to shrink or become smaller.
The level of a building; story number. Not the ground itself.
A group of musicians, not a strip or loop.
Physical money (coins and notes), not change or a till.
The season, not a coil or a water source.
To have clothing on your body, not to damage by use.
A location where someone lives, not a formal speech.
Actually happened, not exaggeration for effect.
A person receiving medical care, not the adjective meaning tolerant.
A living creature in water, not the food on a plate.
Happy or carefree, an older or poetic sense.
A living organism that grows from soil, not a factory or machinery.
A mark or stain on a surface, not to notice or see something.
A prize or honour received, not to give or distribute something.
A solid chunk or group of things, not to obstruct or prevent.
A remark or opinion, not to comment on something (which is a verb).
First in importance or order, not the school level in some countries.
A place where things are bought, not to shop for or search for something.
Ill with an illness, not tired of something or vomiting (in some dialects).
To seize or grab, not to catch an illness or a train (derived senses).
A tiny unit of living tissue, not a prison room or mobile phone.
A medicine or substance, not an illegal narcotic only.
A system of production and trade, not frugality or saving money.
The natural surroundings and conditions, not a person's surroundings generally.
A manager or high-ranking official, not someone who executes.
A quantity of matter, not a large crowd or religious service.
To burst or make a sudden sound, not a soft drink or popular music.
To make or manufacture something, not agricultural products.
Atmospheric conditions like rain or wind, not to survive or withstand.
Short for application; informal, especially for phone/tablet software.
A department or section of an organization, not a math operation.
Real, genuine, existing in fact — not current or present-day.
Having no money, not the past tense of break.
Able to move; often means a portable phone device.
A metalworker, not just a common surname.
A vertical pole or stake, not a mail message or job position.
One only, not unmarried.
A small piece, not a small amount of time.
Not on time or after the usual hour — not deceased.
A location or place — not a website.
A document or data stored — not a music disc or best achievement.
Delicate porcelain material — not the country.
Used up money — not tired or finished with energy.
A winning card in card games — not to surpass or a political figure.
A test or experiment — not a legal court case.
A large amount — not a land plot or group of items.
An agreement or bargain — not cards distributed.
A mother or father — not a company that owns another.
An invoice for payment — not a bird's beak or banknote.
Supply kept on hand — not shares of a company.
To think about something, to ask yourself — not to feel amazement.
A group of people appointed for a task, or a payment for selling something.
Happening now; not recent news or electricity.
A measurement of speed or proportion (e.g. per hour, per 100 people), not a ranking.
To rescue from danger, or to keep money/files. Not just to rescue.
A nobleman or feudal master — a historical title, not a casual form of address.
A hard stone object, not music or motion.
An expert or professional. Also: in favour of (as a debate position).
A female child or young woman, not a female sex worker.
A higher education institution (university-level), not just a secondary school.
Satisfactory/okay, or a monetary penalty — very different senses.
Apologizing for wrongdoing; not expressing pity or poor quality.
A plan or course of action, not political activities or insurance document.
A group of employees, or a stick/rod used as support or symbol.
To demand payment, to attack, or to take responsibility — pick one from context.
A journey visiting places of interest, not just a long journey or rotation.
Older in age, or higher in rank/seniority — context determines which.
Impressive in scale or appearance, not just large or 1,000 dollars.
